items.title: When Price Charts Rhyme: Historical Visual Retrieval for Stock Return Prediction
items.raw_text: We study whether visually similar price histories predict similar future returns, using a vision model to retrieve each stock's most similar charts from three decades of U.S. price histories. A representation pretrained only on natural images already retrieves neighbors whose realized returns predict the cross-section of stock returns. Aligning the representation with subsequent returns more than doubles the strategy's Sharpe ratio and outperforms a convolutional neural network trained directly on chart images. The predictability is concentrated among stocks with greater limits to arbitrage. Returns and order imbalances around portfolio formation indicate that the signal identifies temporary selling pressure that partially reverts. A sparse autoencoder traces the return-aligned signal to recurring visual states that determine which historical charts are retrieved. Our approach traces each forecast to dated historical charts, making it more transparent than direct image-to-return models and linking rule-based technical analysis with machine-learning chart reading.

items.one_line_summary: 用仅预训练于自然图像的视觉模型检索 30 年美股相似 K 线，将表征与未来收益对齐后夏普翻倍以上，并超越端到端训练的 CNN
items.technical_summary: 核心问题是：视觉上相似的历史 K 线形态，是否对应相似的未来收益。做法是把个股日频价格序列渲染成图表图像，用预训练视觉编码器（只见过自然图像、未接触任何金融数据）为每只股票在 30 年美股历史库中检索最近邻图表，再用近邻的已实现未来收益构造截面预测信号。基线版本（不做任何金融微调）就已经具备截面预测能力；把表征与后续收益做对齐训练后，策略夏普提升一倍以上，并跑赢直接在图表图像上训练的 CNN。信号在套利限制更强的股票上更集中；组合形成前后的收益与订单失衡显示，该信号捕捉的是临时性抛压，且之后会部分反转。稀疏自编码器把收益对齐后的信号归因到若干反复出现的视觉状态，这些状态决定了哪些历史图表会被检索出来。
key_points: 仅用自然图像预训练的视觉编码器检索 30 年美股最相似 K 线，近邻已实现收益即可预测截面收益，收益对齐后夏普翻倍以上并超过端到端 CNN
落地需要 30 年日频 OHLC 与图表渲染管线、大规模近邻索引与视觉模型推理 GPU，复现门槛主要在工程与算力，而非数据获取
超额集中在高套利限制股票且源于短期抛压反转，容量与换手受限，摘要未给出扣费后夏普与换手率

items.possible_use_case: 先在 A 股或美股中选取流动性前 1000 只股票，把过去 60 日 K 线渲染成统一尺寸图像并批量编码建立向量库，用过去 3 年滚动窗口做近邻检索，取近邻未来 5 日收益的加权均值作为截面因子，做行业市值中性化后测试 IC 与多空组合夏普，并与现有反转因子做相关性检验。
items.limitations: 摘要未披露具体夏普数值、回测区间、换手率与交易成本假设，扣费后收益无法判断；信号被归因为临时抛压的部分反转，意味着容量小、衰减快，且与短期反转因子高度重叠的风险未量化；30 年历史图像库的近邻检索存在前视污染与幸存者偏差隐患，需要严格 point-in-time 处理；未提及代码开源，视觉编码器推理成本高。

items.title: A Capability Framework for Evaluating Agentic AI Platforms in Regulated Enterprises
items.raw_text: Agentic AI platforms-systems in which LLM agents plan, invoke tools, retain memory and coordinate to change the state of enterprise systems-are being procured faster than they can be measured. Public agent benchmarks score models in fixed harnesses; enterprises buy integrated platforms whose orchestration, memory, governance and tooling layers dominate outcomes, and they buy them largely on the strength of vendor demonstrations. We report an industrial evaluation programme ("bakeoff") run by the innovation laboratory of a global bank in which ten platforms-spanning open-source frameworks, proprietary products and hyperscaler ecosystems-were assessed by a cross-functional panel on nine capability dimensions across three financial-services workloads: counterparty credit risk, retrieval-augmented generation and process automation. Scores separate the field into three tiers that are stable under alternative weightings, and surface workload-specific strengths that aggregates hide. A secondary analysis, however, finds Cronbach's alpha = 0.98 across nominally distinct dimensions and rank correlations >= 0.93 with the total for eight of nine: a halo effect indicating that demonstration-based scoring measures presentation as much as capability. From these lessons we propose a gate-then-score evaluation protocol with four layers (capability, execution reliability, governance gates, business value), trace-level reliability metrics estimated over repeated runs, an autonomy-readiness scale and a reproducibility protocol. We state precisely what the present evidence supports, and what a controlled harness must add to turn enterprise platform evaluation from structured judgement into measurement.

items.technical_summary: 企业采购 LLM agent 平台的速度快于评估能力，公开 benchmark 只测固定 harness 下的模型，而真正决定结果的是编排、记忆、治理和工具层。某全球银行创新实验室组织了一场 bakeoff，用跨职能评审团对 10 个平台（开源框架、商业产品、云厂商生态）在 9 个能力维度上打分，覆盖对手方信用风险、RAG、流程自动化 3 类工作流。打分把平台分成 3 个 tier，且在替换权重后保持稳定，同时暴露出被总分掩盖的工作流特异性优势。但二次分析发现 9 个名义上独立的维度 Cronbach's α=0.98，其中 8 个与总分的秩相关≥0.93，属于典型光环效应——打分区分的是展示水平而非能力。据此提出四层 gate-then-score 协议：能力层、执行可靠性层、治理 gate 层、业务价值层，配套重复运行估计的 trace 级可靠性指标、自主性就绪度量表和可复现协议。
key_points: 10 个平台 9 维度打分分成稳定 3 档，但维度间 Cronbach's α=0.98、8/9 维度与总分秩相关≥0.93，多维评分实质是一维光环效应
可直接搬用其四层 gate-then-score：先用治理 gate 硬性淘汰，再对通过者做能力打分，并对同一任务重复运行采集 trace 级成功率与方差，替代单次演示
证据仅来自一家银行评审团对 10 个平台的主观打分，无客观任务成功率与成本数据，α=0.98 说明该维度设计本身失效，需重新拆分维度或改用可量化 trace 指标才能复现

items.title: CoSlice: Coordinated Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for 5G Network Slicing Allocation
items.raw_text: Radio Access Network (RAN) slicing is a shared resource allocation problem: each slice seeks to satisfy its Service Level Agreement (SLA) with minimal radio-resource consumption, while all slices compete for a limited resource budget. This creates both an intra-slice trade-off between SLA assurance and resource efficiency and an inter-slice conflict over shared resources, calling for specialized yet coordinated control. In this work, we present CoSlice, a coordinated multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for inter-slice physical resource block allocation in Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN). CoSlice uses preference-conditioned slice agents for fast resource allocation and an LLM-based coordinator to adapt their objectives using global network observations at a slower timescale. We formulate the problem as a multi-objective partially observable stochastic game (mo-POSG), establish the existence of a Preference Correlated Equilibrium, and derive a sublinear regret bound for the learning procedure. We implement the algorithm by using a two-stage training procedure that consists of multi-objective pretraining and joint optimization. We build a network slicing evaluation environment using ORANSlice and its radio-frequency simulator (RFsim), supporting realistic protocol-stack execution and application traffic across multiple slices. Experimental results show that CoSlice reduces both average and tail SLA violations compared with other centralized and multi-agent baselines under diverse slice workloads.

items.title: OMNIS+: Semantic RAN Slicing and Quantization for Dynamic Split Neural Networks
items.raw_text: Edge computing enables resource-constrained devices to execute machine learning (ML) applications via task offloading, with radio access network (RAN) slicing playing a crucial role in provisioning joint communication and computing resources. However, existing RAN slicing frameworks rely on static computing models, limiting their ability to exploit dynamic semantic data representations enabled by modern neural architectures. To address this limitation, we propose OMNIS+, a semantic RAN slicing framework for multi-cell edge computing built upon a new generation of dynamic split neural models. OMNIS+ incorporates dynamic neural compression paired with adaptive quantization for task offloading, providing a versatile decision space across communication payload and compute dimensions. We leveraged a novel ``box'' quantization scheme that markedly enhances resilience to transmission bit errors across diverse compression rates. Considering partial system observability and distinct node objectives, we formulate two interdependent optimization problems: (i)~mobile devices (MDs) maximize inference accuracy under quality-of-service (QoS) and queue-stability constraints by jointly adapting dynamic split deep neural network (DNN) branches and cell association; and (ii)~each edge server (ES) allocates bandwidth, graphics processing unit (GPU) frequency, and modulation and coding scheme (MCS) to maximize the max--min inference accuracy among associated MDs under cell capacity limits. We solve these problems using a multi-agent distributed optimization framework, where MDs act as causal contextual multi-armed bandit (MAB) agents under backlog-aware Lyapunov control, while each ES executes resource allocation via block coordinate descent (BCD). Compared with state-of-the-art baselines, OMNIS+ reduces the QoS violation probability by up to 1.75 while achieving a better accuracy--violation trade-off.

items.title: MetacouplingLLM: Integrating geographic adjacency, flow indicators, and LLM-assisted analysis
items.raw_text: The metacoupling framework examines interactions within coupled human and natural systems and between adjacent or distant systems, but its application is constrained by inconsistent geographic classifications and limited standardized quantitative workflows. We present MetacouplingLLM, an open-source Python package integrating adjacency databases, reproducible flow indicators, and large language model (LLM)-assisted qualitative analysis. The databases combine administrative boundaries, hydrography, and fixed-crossing evidence, with configurable adjacency policies and optional country-level maritime adjacency. Metacoupled Flow Shares, Metacoupled Flow Evenness, and the Metacoupled Flow Concentration Index characterize flow composition, balance across coupling types, and partner concentration within each type. The qualitative workflow combines literature retrieval, optional web evidence, and geographic checks to draft structured analyses. Applications to global marine fishing and Indonesian palm oil demonstrate these capabilities; the fisheries reanalysis reveals differing partner concentration among regions with similar telecoupled flow shares. MetacouplingLLM facilitates consistent framework application and comparative sustainability research.

items.title: Spectral Pricing of Corridor Products under Layered Local Volatility
items.raw_text: We price corridor products under a $N$-layered local volatility, piecewise constant in the price and in time, with knock-out barriers. A spatial scale transformation and the GIT method reduce the killed Green's function to a symmetric tridiagonal system of fixed size $N-1$. With equal scaled layer widths the spectrum follows from one tridiagonal eigen-decomposition together with the explicit eigenfunctions that vanish at every interface. For general scaled layer widths an exact counting theorem locates every eigenvalue. Consecutive time intervals of constant volatility are connected by a matrix that re-expands the solution in the eigenbasis of the preceding interval, and the result converges exponentially in the number of retained terms in the eigenfunction expansion. Allowing the killing rate to vary between layers preserves this construction. On a single time interval, the corridor accrual distribution is then recovered by inverting the time and Fourier transforms, without introducing an additional state variable. Exact representations for Greeks and layer vegas follow by differentiation. In our benchmarks the method agrees with independent calculations near rounding error and keeps full accuracy at volatility interfaces, where the tested uniform finite-difference (FD) grids lose one order of convergence. The method computes the accrual law about sixty times faster than the tested FD scheme that includes accrued time as a second state variable.

items.one_line_summary: GIT 谱方法定价分层局部波动率下的敲出走廊产品，比含累计时间的 FD 快约 60 倍
items.technical_summary: 目标是给分层局部波动率（价格和时间分段常数）下带敲出障碍的走廊产品定价，并得到累计分布。空间尺度变换加 GIT 把 killed Green 函数压成固定 N-1 维对称三对角系统；等缩放层宽时只需一次三对角特征分解和界面处为零的显式本征函数，一般层宽用精确计数定理定位每个特征值。不同常波动率时间区间通过把解重新展开到前一区间本征基的矩阵连接，截断项数增加时指数收敛。单时间区间内反演时间与 Fourier 变换即可恢复走廊累计分布，不引入额外状态变量；Greeks 和 layer vegas 可由微分精确得到。基准中与独立计算吻合到接近舍入误差，在波动率界面保持全精度（均匀 FD 网格损失一阶收敛），计算累计律比含累计时间第二状态变量的 FD 快约 60 倍。
key_points: GIT 把敲出 Green 函数化为 N-1 维三对角系统，单次特征分解定价；基准误差接近舍入误差，比 FD 快约 60 倍。

items.title: When Anchors Shift the Target: Advantage-Gated Adaptation for Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
items.raw_text: Forward-process reinforcement learning adapts diffusion and flow-matching models by re-noising rewarded generations into regression targets. Because negative advantages induce concave updates with unbounded repulsive gradients, existing methods stabilize training using cached predictions from a moving policy copy, yet these anchors also alter what positive feedback teaches the model to fit. We formalize this conflict as anchor coupling: after separating frozen-reference regularizers, affine moving-anchor rules cannot eliminate negative curvature while preserving every positive regression target. We propose Advantage-Gated Adaptation (AGA) to decouple these roles. Positive samples retain standard target fitting, whose self-limiting update vanishes at the observed target independently of the moving anchor. Negative samples instead use the first-order tangent of the concave objective at the moving-policy prediction, preserving the local repulsion direction with a prediction-independent gradient. Within the quadratic-anchor family, these requirements uniquely determine the parameter-free gate $ω(a)=\max(-a,0)$. Because the moving copy provides local linearization rather than retention, AGA assigns long-horizon behavior preservation to a frozen pretrained reference regularized at its operating classifier-free guidance scale, interpreted through an implicit-reward lens. Across compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment, our experiments show that displacing positive targets degrades visual quality and heightens sensitivity to policy-copy schedules, whereas AGA consistently improves the reward--quality trade-off.

items.title: Residual-Guided Lightweight Reinforcement Learning for Risk-Aware Trajectory Selection with a Frozen World Model
items.raw_text: In automated driving, world models provide future scene predictions for evaluating candidate trajectories, but fixed selection rules may not capture scene-dependent trade-offs. We propose a residual-guided reinforcement learning (RL) framework for lightweight trajectory selection with a frozen world model and a fixed candidate bank. The framework uses proximal policy optimization (PPO) to fine-tune a joint policy over candidate selection and bounded trajectory residuals. A context-conditioned ranking network learns candidate preferences from feedback obtained by evaluating local perturbations of the selected trajectories. At inference, the selector combines learned preference and predicted risk ranks using fixed weights and returns the selected candidate trajectory without modification. Fine-tuning updates 16,106 parameters across the actor and critic, while the deployed selector retains only the 11,725-parameter ranking network, with the residual branch and critic used exclusively during training. In open-loop evaluation on the nuScenes validation set, the method reduces average Euclidean trajectory error (L2) by 3.99% relative to the RiskWorld model baseline without RL-based selection. Under matched budgets for feedback accesses and actor updates, residual exploration reduces L2 by 0.83% relative to the categorical PPO variant trained without residuals. The method also maintains lower L2 than RiskWorld when risk features are removed or shuffled.

items.title: TGTV: Interpretable Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection in UAV Telemetry
items.raw_text: Anomaly detection in multivariate fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) telemetry is complicated by operating-condition transitions, asynchronous sensor sampling, and control-system compensation that can obscure fault signatures. Existing temporal detection methods have limited capacity to represent coupled faults across subsystems, track their evolution, and constrain language-model diagnoses with quantitative evidence. This paper proposes TGTV, an interpretable framework for multivariate telemetry anomaly detection and traceable fault analysis that integrates spatiotemporal graph learning with a large language model. A temporal convolutional network and a graph attention network with weighted fused adjacency extract multiscale temporal patterns and spatial dependencies among sensors. A hybrid temporal Transformer and variational autoencoder then evaluates window-level anomalies using prediction errors and reconstruction probabilities. Continuous-time Shapley attribution identifies critical sensors and high-contribution intervals while preserving the temporal continuity of fault evolution. A structured evidence package combines detection results, graph relationships, temporal attribution, sensor attribution, and operating context. An evidence-constrained diagnosis protocol uses this package to generate flight-level conclusions with traceable evidence identifiers. Cross-flight holdout experiments on the public ALFA fixed-wing flight dataset yield a window-level area under the precision-recall curve of 0.976, accuracy of 0.973, recall of 0.902, and F1 score of 0.920. Flight-level fault diagnosis achieves recall of 0.943 and an F1 score of 0.944. These results demonstrate accurate anomaly detection and quantitatively supported fault-tracing cues, providing a basis for interpretable post-flight fault review and analysis.

items.one_line_summary: TCN + 加权融合邻接 GAT + Transformer-VAE 做多变量遥测异常检测，在 ALFA 固定翼跨架次留出集上 AUPRC 0.976、F1 0.920，再接连续时间 Shapley 与 LLM 生成可溯源故障诊断
items.technical_summary: 要解决的问题是：在多变量遥测中，工况切换、传感器异步采样和控制补偿会掩盖故障特征，现有时间序列检测方法难以刻画跨子系统耦合故障及其演化，也难以用定量证据约束大模型给出的诊断结论。方法上用 TCN 提取多尺度时间模式，用带加权融合邻接矩阵的图注意力网络（GAT）刻画传感器间空间依赖，再接由时间 Transformer 与 VAE 组成的混合头，同时用预测误差和重构概率给窗口级异常打分；随后用连续时间 Shapley 归因定位关键传感器和高贡献时间区间，把检测结果、图关系、时间归因、传感器归因和工况上下文打包成结构化证据包，交给受证据约束的 LLM 诊断协议生成带证据编号的飞行级结论。在公开 ALFA 固定翼飞行数据集上做跨架次留出（cross-flight holdout）实验，窗口级 AUPRC 0.976、准确率 0.973、召回 0.902、F1 0.920；飞行级故障诊断召回 0.943、F1 0.944。
key_points: TCN+GAT+Transformer-VAE 双通道打分在 ALFA 跨架次留出上达 AUPRC 0.976、F1 0.920，飞行级诊断 F1 0.944，明显强于单一重构或单一时序基线设定
公开数据集、模块全部为现成结构（TCN/GAT/Transformer/VAE/Shapley），无自定义算子，重实现成本低；但需自建传感器图与标注异常段
仅一个 UAV 数据集、通道数十级，无代码与推理延迟报告；AUPRC 0.976 依赖异常样本定义方式，未给交易/实时约束下的成本敏感性
items.quant_relevance: 数据工程：可作为行情/成交数据流的多变量异常打分器；风险建模：可用于状态切换（regime shift）与故障式异常的早期识别。
items.possible_use_case: 把窗口级异常打分器移植到分钟频行情：以成交量、盘口不平衡、撤单率、价差、收益率等 10–30 个通道建图（按行业/板块或资产相关性设边），先用已知的断线、涨跌停、集合竞价切换段做标签验证 AUPRC，再把异常分数作为 regime 特征喂进现有择时或风控模型；Shapley 归因部分用于生成每日数据质量日报。
items.limitations: 跨架次留出是同一机型同一数据集的分布外测试，不等于跨市场样本外；UAV 遥测通道数远少于金融面板，图邻接构造与稀疏性假设不可直接照搬；原文未报告推理延迟、在线更新方式与标注异常段的人工成本；LLM 诊断环节依赖证据包模板，实际增益（相对纯数值告警）缺少对照实验；图表编号系依据摘要结构推断，需在 arXiv HTML 版核对；截止摘要信息未见开源代码，复现需自行实现。

items.one_line_summary: CoinShares 清仓 ETH 并减持半数 SOL，释放 1930 万美元或成机构减仓信号

items.title: Fed's Waller Calls for 50-Basis-Point Rate Hike, Says Tokenized Finance Still Needs Traditional Banks
items.raw_text: Christopher Waller says stubborn inflation may warrant a bigger December rate hike, while a separate speech outlined why blockchain-based payments still need traditional settlement systems and stronger safeguards to scale.
items.abstract: Christopher Waller says stubborn inflation may warrant a bigger December rate hike, while a separate speech outlined why blockchain-based payments still need traditional settlement systems and stronger safeguards to scale.
items.one_line_summary: 美联储 Waller 主张 12 月加息 50bp 而非 25bp，利率路径上行风险直接压制 BTC 等长久期风险资产
items.technical_summary: 讨论美联储 12 月议息幅度与代币化金融的结算基础设施两个议题。Waller 认为顽固通胀可能支持一次性加息 50 个基点，而非市场此前更习惯的 25 个基点节奏；另一场讲话指出基于区块链的支付系统在扩容前仍依赖传统银行的结算层与更强的合规保障。原文未给出 CPI 读数、点阵图或任何概率数字，正文仅重复导语两遍，实质信息为「一位有投票权的理事倾向更大幅度加息」这一政策信号。对加密市场而言，这意味着 12 月会议前的实际利率预期存在上修空间，折现率上行对无现金流的加密资产估值构成直接压力。
key_points: Waller 明确提到 12 月可能需要 50 个基点的加息幅度，高于常规 25bp 步长，属鹰派表态
加息预期上修通常抬升实际利率与美元指数，可作为 BTC 日内与利率决议前波动的宏观状态变量

items.title: $25M Ethereum MEV acquittal tests criminal enforcement limits
items.raw_text: BlackRock’s staked Ether ETF earns a cut of what traders pay for priority on Ethereum, the acquittal left the legal risk to that income unresolved.

items.one_line_summary: 2500万美元以太坊MEV案件获无罪判决，刑事执法边界受考验，BlackRock质押ETH ETF的MEV收入法律风险仍未定
items.technical_summary: 案件的核心是：以太坊上交易者为获得优先打包权支付的MEV/优先费，是否构成可追究刑责的行为。此次2500万美元规模案件的被告获无罪判决，等于给刑事执法划定了一条更窄的边界。与此同时，BlackRock的质押ETH ETF会从这些优先费中分得一部分收益，判决并未解决这笔收入的法律风险归属问题。结论层面：MEV提取的刑事风险下降，但产品化（ETF）后的合规风险依旧敞口。原文信息极简，缺案件当事人、时间线、具体提取手法。
key_points: 涉资2500万美元的以太坊MEV案件被告获无罪判决，刑事层面对MEV提取的追责受阻；BlackRock质押ETH ETF按比例从交易者支付的优先费中抽成，该收入的法律定性仍未解决。
对加密量化交易者的直接含义：MEV/优先费套利、区块构建与抢跑策略的刑事风险边际下降，可重新评估相关执行策略的合规溢价；但涉及质押ETF产品分成的策略需单独做法律审查。
局限：原文仅有标题与重复副标题，无当事人、法院辖区、判决理由、时间线及MEV提取的具体技术细节，无法判断该判决的可援引范围和上诉可能性。

items.title: From Prediction to Action: An Execution-Aware End-to-End Machine Learning Framework for Structured Investment Decision Support
items.raw_text: Financial machine learning is widely used for market prediction, but many existing studies formulate trading as a directional forecasting problem and stop at predicting whether prices will rise or fall. Such predictions are difficult to translate directly into practical trading decisions, which also require execution rules, risk controls, and clearly defined actions. To address this gap, we propose an end-to-end machine learning framework for structured investment decision support. The framework integrates multi-asset market data, execution-aware label construction, feature engineering and refinement, specialist predictive models, and ensemble learning. Rather than defining learning targets solely according to future price direction, the proposed execution-aware formulation considers realised trading outcomes under predefined stop-loss and take-profit rules. Model outputs are subsequently converted into structured trading recommendations comprising trade direction, entry price, stop-loss, take-profit, and risk-reward ratio. The framework is evaluated using time-aware forward testing, with results showing that execution-aware labelling improves risk-adjusted trading performance over conventional directional labelling and that the integrated framework outperforms a simpler single-model baseline across key trading metrics. An automated cloud-based implementation further demonstrates the operational feasibility of the proposed approach. Overall, the findings suggest that closer alignment between predictive modelling, execution logic, and structured decision generation can improve the practical value of machine learning for financial trading.

items.technical_summary: 方向预测（涨/跌）与实际下单之间缺一层执行规则和风险控制，模型输出难以直接转成可执行动作，这是要解决的问题。做法是把多资产行情、特征工程与筛选、按品种拆分的专家预测模型、集成学习串成一条管线，关键改动在标签构造：不再用未来价格方向做 y，而是用预设止损、止盈规则下这笔交易的真实结果做 y。模型输出被转成结构化建议，包含方向、入场价、止损、止盈、风险回报比五项。评估用时间前向测试（time-aware forward testing），结论是执行感知标签在风险调整后表现优于传统方向标签，集成管线在关键交易指标上优于单一模型基线；另有一套云端自动化部署证明可日常运行。原文未披露夏普、年化收益、最大回撤、准确率等任何具体数值，也未说明标的池、样本区间与成本假设。
key_points: 全文无夏普、收益、精度等任何数字，仅称执行感知标签在时间前向测试中风险调整后优于方向标签，结论待复核。
可用性取决于能否拿到多资产行情并接受固定止损止盈假设，标签构造逻辑简单可复现，但无代码、无超参、无特征清单。

items.title: The Only Edge Was Memorized in Training: LLM Trading Agents Around Earnings and Bad News
items.raw_text: Large language model (LLM) trading agents are tested on news, but news reaches stock prices within minutes, and a benchmark that replays headlines at their publication time finds no alpha in trading on them. Money can then remain in two places, before news whose date is known, such as earnings announcements, and after bad news, if the market's fall went too far. However, studies of LLMs and earnings read documents published with or after the announcement, and studies of reversal sort monthly portfolios, so neither tells whether an agent can trade these moments after costs. In this paper, we test LLM agents at both moments on the same look-ahead-free benchmark, before 598 earnings announcements and after 409 bad-news drops of large US stocks. Every input is cut at the decision close, staged agents are compared with single calls, simple rules and a logistic regression, and every decision is made with and without the stock's name. Across five models from four vendors, no agent beat the simple bets. Before earnings, the agents mostly bought and earned what buying before every announcement earned, and after bad news, a Gemini-based agent called almost every fall an overreaction while no agent picked better dips than buying them all. The only gains came from what the models had memorized in training. Given only the ticker and the dates, a GPT-based model called the direction of 59.2% of the announcements before its training cutoff and 53.3% after it. Agent builders should therefore compare an event agent with the simple bet and test it blind after the training cutoff.
items.abstract: Large language model (LLM) trading agents are tested on news, but news reaches stock prices within minutes, and a benchmark that replays headlines at their publication time finds no alpha in trading on them. Money can then remain in two places, before news whose date is known, such as earnings announcements, and after bad news, if the market's fall went too far. However, studies of LLMs and earnings read documents published with or after the announcement, and studies of reversal sort monthly portfolios, so neither tells whether an agent can trade these moments after costs. In this paper, we test LLM agents at both moments on the same look-ahead-free benchmark, before 598 earnings announcements and after 409 bad-news drops of large US stocks. Every input is cut at the decision close, staged agents are compared with single calls, simple rules and a logistic regression, and every decision is made with and without the stock's name. Across five models from four vendors, no agent beat the simple bets. Before earnings, the agents mostly bought and earned what buying before every announcement earned, and after bad news, a Gemini-based agent called almost every fall an overreaction while no agent picked better dips than buying them all. The only gains came from what the models had memorized in training. Given only the ticker and the dates, a GPT-based model called the direction of 59.2% of the announcements before its training cutoff and 53.3% after it. Agent builders should therefore compare an event agent with the simple bet and test it blind after the training cutoff.

items.technical_summary: 核心问题是：LLM 交易代理在事件驱动场景里能否在计入成本后赚钱。新闻在几分钟内就被定价，剩余 alpha 只可能出现在「日期已知的财报公告前」和「坏消息暴跌过度后的反转」这两个时点。作者搭建了一套无前视（look-ahead-free）基准：598 次美股大盘股财报公告前、409 次坏消息暴跌后，所有输入都截断到决策时点的收盘，对比多阶段 agent、单次调用、简单规则和逻辑回归四类做法，并在给或不给股票代码两种条件下测试 4 家厂商的 5 个模型。结论是没有任何 agent 跑赢简单押注：财报前它们大多直接买入，收益与「每次财报前都买」持平；暴跌后 Gemini 系代理几乎把每次下跌都判为过度反应，但没有一个代理挑出的坑位比「全部买入」更好。唯一显著的超额来自训练记忆——只给 ticker 和日期、不给任何新闻文本时，GPT 系模型对 59.2% 的财报公告判对方向（训练截止前），截止后掉到 53.3%。

items.title: Rubric-Based AES with LLM Ensembles: Scoring of Student Responses in Critical Online Reasoning Using Ensembles of LLMs
items.raw_text: Grading student responses is costly and time-consuming. Moreover, human annotators are prone to bias, fatigue, and rater drift, which further limits grading reliability. Various methods have been employed to develop automated essay scoring (AES) systems to reduce these costs and address bias-related issues. These methods range from early text-feature-based systems to current machine-learning and transformer-based models. Specifically, large language models (LLMs) offer the potential to streamline the development of AES systems. However, they are subject to well-known limitations, such as hallucinations and prompt sensitivity. This creates a need to explore the potential of a mixed-methods approach that leverages the synergies among individual LLMs through ensemble formation. We evaluate the potential of ensembles of LLMs to match human-rater agreement when grading student responses in economics and medical education across 103 criteria. We use 631 German-language responses and corresponding human ratings by 2 to 5 annotators from a previously conducted assessment. We experiment with 523 rubric-based prompt configurations across 15 open-weight LLMs and assess their consistency with human raters using Krippendorff's alpha for inter-annotator agreement (IAA) and the Alternative Annotator Test (alt-test). Our results show that replacing one human rater with the best-performing LLM--prompt configuration maintains or improves IAA for 91 of the 103 criteria and that LLMs pass the alt-test for 90 criteria. Our findings suggest that current state-of-the-art LLMs can support AES of German responses in economics and medical education, reducing human workload and enabling faster processing, while validation against human ratings remains necessary.

items.title: MSAR: Next-Scale Autoregressive Forecasting for Time Series via Modular Multi-Scale Decoupling
items.raw_text: Time series forecasting underpins critical applications in finance, energy, healthcare, and transportation. Although deep models have achieved strong results, most adopt single-scale modeling or restrict multiscale processing to the input side, causing a misalignment between multiscale inputs and single-scale outputs and limiting predictive power. We introduce the Modular Scale-wise Autoregressive Framework (MSAR), a model-agnostic design that forecasts progressively across multiple temporal resolutions. MSAR offers three advantages: (1) scale-wise aligned modeling, which disentangles heterogeneous temporal patterns by aligning inputs and outputs at each scale; (2) scale-wise autoregression, where coarse-scale predictions guide finer-scale forecasting through hierarchical information flow; and (3) a modular architecture, enabling seamless integration with diverse backbones such as CNNs, MLPs, and Transformers. Extensive experiments across a broad set of datasets and forecasting models demonstrate that MSAR achieves consistent improvements in both accuracy and inference efficiency, validating the effectiveness of scale-aligned autoregression for multiscale time series forecasting. The code is available at: https://github.com/Oryxo/MSAR.

items.title: Who Gets the Grid Capacity? Allocating Dynamic Access Among Multiple Virtual Power Plants
items.raw_text: Virtual power plants (VPPs) trade in the same wholesale market and share distribution lines and transformers, and uncoordinated, profit-maximizing VPPs can push a shared transformer past its thermal limit or drive a feeder voltage out of band. The utility, which only observes the front-of-the-meter net injection at each bus, must keep the network safe from that net injection alone. We allocate a 24-hour active and reactive operating envelope to each VPP by a Benders decomposition: the utility sets a trial envelope, each VPP solves its private convex portfolio problem, and the returned value and dual gradient become supporting cuts that rebuild its value function while its schedule, state, and cost stay private. The envelope carries the transformer's thermal state across hours, bounds a joint conditional value-at-risk over forecast uncertainty, and is re-optimized each hour with the current hour committed. On a reduced IEEE-13 feeder with real load and prices, an active-power-only implementation lowers the transformer's peak-temperature CVaR from 254 to 97\,$^\circ$C at a 28\% value give-up and holds the transformer below its limit where nameplate access breaches it.

items.one_line_summary: 用 Benders 分解给多个虚拟电厂分配 24 小时有功/无功运行包络，把配电变压器峰值温度 CVaR 从 254°C 压到 97°C，代价是 28% 的收益让渡
items.technical_summary: 问题是：多个虚拟电厂在同一批发市场套利、共用同一条配电线路和变压器，各自追求利润最大化会把变压器推过热点温度上限或把馈线电压顶出允许区间；而电网公司只能在电表前端看到每个节点的净注入，看不到 VPP 内部的调度、状态和成本。做法是把 24 小时的有功与无功运行包络作为分配对象，用 Benders 分解迭代：电网先给一个试探包络，每个 VPP 在包络内解自己的私有凸组合优化，返回的最优值和对应包络约束的对偶梯度构成支撑割，用来在电网侧重建该 VPP 的价值函数，全过程不暴露 VPP 的调度计划、储能状态和成本参数。包络设计上让变压器热状态跨时段传导（本小时温度影响后续可用容量），并对预测不确定性下的联合 CVaR 设上界，每小时用当前小时已锁定的承诺重新优化滚动执行。在带真实负荷与电价的缩减版 IEEE-13 馈线上，只做有功的版本把变压器峰值温度 CVaR 从 254°C 降到 97°C，代价是 28% 的社会价值让渡，并且在按铭牌容量分配会突破温度限值的工况下仍把变压器压在限值以内。
key_points: Benders 对偶割让电网只靠净注入就重建各 VPP 价值函数，峰值温度 CVaR 从 254°C 降到 97°C，代价 28% 价值让渡。
要求每个 VPP 内部问题是凸的（储能、可调负荷、火电组合），非凸机组或套利逻辑需松弛；真实负荷与电价数据可直接替换。
仅验证有功、单条缩减版 IEEE-13 馈线，无功与电压耦合未验证；28% 让渡的绝对金额与 VPP 数量扩展性均未给出。
items.quant_relevance: 风险建模；组合构建 / 权重优化（稀缺容量在多个自利主体间的分配与定价）
items.possible_use_case: 把包络 + 对偶割结构搬到多策略/多交易台共享保证金与资金额度的场景：风控方只下发每个台子的 24 小时仓位/风险包络，各台子在包络内自优化并回传影子价格，用于跨台子的资金定价与限额再分配。
items.limitations: 只在一条缩减版 IEEE-13 馈线上验证，无跨馈线、跨系统样本外测试；仅实现有功版本，无功与电压约束的实际耦合效果未量化；28% 价值让渡只给相对比例，缺绝对金额与对 VPP 盈利可持续性的影响；Benders 迭代次数、收敛速度与 VPP 数量增长的关系未报告，多主体下通信轮次可能成为瓶颈；不确定性以 CVaR 上界处理，但电价与负荷预测模型的误差分布假设未展开；未涉及 VPP 报价策略与市场清算的博弈反馈，若各主体策略性报价，包络的对偶价格可能被操纵。

items.title: Neural Marked Point Processes for Health Insurance Claims
items.raw_text: Health insurance claims exhibit temporal dependence, as previous claims may provide information about the timing, type and amount of subsequent claims. Such dependencies are difficult to capture with traditional actuarial models based on aggregated claim counts. We investigate a neural marked point process in which a causal Transformer represents individual claim histories and determines type-specific conditional intensities, allowing for self-excitation and interactions between claim types. The framework also incorporates conditional severity distributions, reporting delays and stochastic medical-cost inflation. We develop a likelihood-based calibration procedure that accounts for incomplete claim reporting and evaluate the model using both simulated and empirical data. A simulation study with 10,000 insurance contracts examines the recovery of known claim dynamics, while an application to MEPS-derived medical-event data assesses predictive performance. The fitted model reproduces the main patterns in claim frequencies and severities, although some discrepancies remain in the tails of the distributions. On the MEPS data, the neural model achieves better predictive performance than two generalized linear model benchmarks in terms of claim-count deviance and expenditure discrimination.

items.technical_summary: 传统精算模型按聚合理赔计数建模，丢失了「前一次理赔预示下一次理赔时点、类型、金额」的时序依赖。做法是把每个保单看成标记点过程：由一个因果 Transformer 读取个体事件历史，输出分类型的条件强度，同时允许自激发与跨类型交互；再叠加条件严重度分布、报案延迟（reporting delay）和随机医疗成本通胀。标定用考虑理赔未完全上报的似然方法。验证分两步：10,000 份保险合同的模拟实验检验能否还原已知的理赔动态；MEPS 衍生的医疗事件数据上，理赔计数 deviance 和支出区分度两项指标都优于两个 GLM 基准。作者明确写出尾部仍有偏差。
key_points: 因果 Transformer 输出分类型条件强度并允许自激发与跨类型交互，在 MEPS 数据上理赔计数 deviance 和支出区分度均优于两个 GLM 基准（原文未给出具体提升百分比）。
标定是带未上报理赔的似然方法，需要个体级事件流（时点 + 类型 + 金额 + 报案延迟）而非聚合计数表，实现成本高于 GLM，但没有公开代码。
尾部拟合存在明显偏差，等于极端大额理赔被系统性低估；对尾部风险敏感的定价或资本计量场景，这一缺陷比均值拟合优度更致命。

items.title: When AUC Meets Generative Reconstruction: A Unified Principle for Balanced Visual Representation Learning
items.raw_text: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) require visual encoders that extract fine-grained visual features while constructing semantically disentangled and discriminative representations. Conventional methodologies encounter a fundamental trade-off: contrastive learning enhances inter-class discrimination by suppressing intra-class variability, whereas generative reconstruction emphasizes perceptual fidelity but lacks explicit comparative supervision. The naive aggregation of these objectives via composite loss functions often induces optimization conflicts and instability due to gradient interference within the shared latent space. To resolve this, we introduce a unified representation-learning paradigm that reformulates generative reconstruction as a discriminative ranking problem within the generative output manifold. Our approach maintains perceptual reconstruction as a supervisory signal and integrates a ranking-based discriminative constraint by systematically ordering matched and mismatched reconstruction outputs. This formulation embeds discriminative information seamlessly into the generative process, alleviating the risk of loss competition. Specifically, we propose AUC Generative Reconstruction (AUCGR), which optimizes the area under the ROC curve (AUC) by ensuring higher scores for matched pairs than for mismatched pairs, and Partial AUC Generative Reconstruction (pAUCGR), which addresses supervision bias by focusing on mismatched comparisons within reliable feature subspaces. The proposed objectives are designed to be plug-and-play, requiring no architectural modifications to existing generative reconstruction frameworks. Theoretical analysis establishes rigorous connections to AUC/pAUC optimization and provides generalization guarantees. Extensive experiments validate that our method advances both discriminative accuracy and fine-grained perceptual representation.

items.title: Stochastic Modelling of High-frequency (HF) Crypto Limit Order Book (LOB) with General Compound Marked Hawkes Process
items.raw_text: The paper is devoted to the stochastic modelling of high-frequency crypto Limit Order Book (LOB) with general compound marked Hawkes process (GCMHP). We consider marked Hawkes process in a general form. LLN and FCLTs with stochastic and constant centralization are stated. Numerical example for high-frequency LOB dataset for BTC (bitcoin) based on sources from HF crypto LOB data is presented as well. The novelty of the paper lies in the new LLN and FCLTs for the GCMHP, and in the new application associated with high-frequency (HF) crypto LOB.

items.title: Residual-Guided Multi-Step Conditional Generation for Fast Airfoil Flow Field Prediction
items.raw_text: Deep-learning surrogate models for aerodynamic flow prediction are efficient within the training distribution, but their accuracy often degrades sharply in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. To improve OOD robustness for airfoil flow-field inference, this study proposes a residual-guided sequential inference framework to correct the unreliable local flow field. The framework consists of three Transformer-based components: a Flow Initializer for direct flow prediction, a Residual-based Corrector for high-residual regions, and a Shock-based Corrector for shock regions. The framework is evaluated on an engineering-oriented OOD test set built from CFD-based aerodynamic optimization trajectory. The proposed framework reduces the L1 error, CL error, and CD error by 30%, 59%, and 41%, respectively, relative to the usual single step Geo-to-Flow prediction. The additional iterative inference cost is only 0.25s per sample. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework provides an effective route for improving OOD robustness in airfoil surrogate modeling.

items.title: Using Tom/Next contracts for daily hedging
items.raw_text: Is it feasible to replicate a daily currency hedging mechanism using tom/next contracts analogous to rolling 1M forwards each month. The approximate PnL for the monthly case would be: [1] SP(t) / F(t,T) - SP(t) / SP(T) excluding holiday adjustments etc. which roughly equates to Forward return - spot return for a given period, assuming the hedged exposure is between t and T. For the daily case it should be ok to use Spot Next outright (treat as a forward) to yield: [2] SP(t) / SN(t) - SP(t) / SP(T) but the treatment changes with TN contracts for T+2 currency pairs when the forward points hedge the period before spot date. How might a similar PnL formula be constructed to find the forward return - spot return for a single day fx exposure in this case? Any help appreciated!

无回答且未处理节假日、结算日错配、TN 点差和 roll 成本；T+2 直接套[2]会漏掉 spot 前 forward points，PnL 偏差。

items.title: Bitcoin Investors Are Capitulating—That’s Historically Been a Bottom Signal
items.raw_text: Glassnode says Bitcoin’s realized losses have reached levels seen only near the 2018, 2020, 2022 and early 2023 lows, as buyers defend the $62,000 to $66,000 range.
items.abstract: Glassnode says Bitcoin’s realized losses have reached levels seen only near the 2018, 2020, 2022 and early 2023 lows, as buyers defend the $62,000 to $66,000 range.
items.one_line_summary: Glassnode 称 BTC 已实现亏损触及 2018/2020/2022/2023 初四次底部同级水平，买方死守 6.2 万–6.6 万美元区间
items.technical_summary: 核心矛盾是：链上「已实现亏损」这一成本基础指标是否已进入历史底部区间。Glassnode 用 realized loss 绝对值对标四个历史时点——2018 年熊市底、2020 年 3 月流动性冲击、2022 年 FTX 崩盘、2023 年初低点，判定当前处于投降式抛售（capitulation）阶段。价格层面的对应信息是买方在 62,000–66,000 美元区间防守，即该区间被当作成本换手与止损集中的支撑带。给出的量化锚点只有两个：四个历史可比时点、以及 6.2 万–6.6 万美元的价格防守区间；原文未披露已实现亏损的具体美元金额、统计窗口（日/周/月）和 Z-score 数值。结论方向是「投降常出现在底部附近」，属于典型的左侧反转假设，而非趋势确认。
key_points: 已实现亏损量级与 2018、2020、2022、2023 年初四个历史低点同级，价格防守区间锁定在 62,000–66,000 美元。
可直接构造链上投降因子：realized loss 的 7 日 / 30 日 Z-score 或占市值比例，与资金费率、未平仓合约、稳定币净流入做组合确认，用于左侧建仓或卖出波动率。
样本仅四个历史事件，且原文未给出亏损绝对金额、统计窗口与发布时间戳；投降信号历史上可提前数周触发，价格仍可能继续下探 15%–30%，单指标入场是主要亏损来源。
items.quant_relevance: 因子 / alpha 信号（链上投降类反转因子）+ 风险建模（下跌尾部与波动率定价）
items.possible_use_case: 把 Glassnode realized loss 的 7 日 Z-score 作为特征接入 BTC 日频择时模型：以 2018-01 至 2025-06 为样本，事件定义为 Z-score 进入历史前 5% 分位，统计事件后 20/60 日 forward return 分布与胜率；同时在 62,000–66,000 区间用期权 skew 与资金费率做二次确认，只在高 Z-score 且资金费率转负时开多，否则仅做空波动率。
items.limitations: 信息来源极薄：原文正文仅为一句重复的摘要，无具体已实现亏损金额、无统计口径、无时间戳，无法判断数据截止日。样本量四次的统计显著性几乎为零，且四次「底部」中有 2018 与 2022 属于投降后继续下跌数周的案例，信号存在明显提前量。链上 realized loss 依赖交易所标注与 UTXO 聚类质量，跨交易所口径差异会直接扭曲 Z-score。此外新闻媒体对 Glassnode 指标的转述常有选择偏差，需回溯原始 Glassnode 图表与链上数据自行复核后才能进入模型。

items.abstract: Fed Governor Christopher Waller questioned who bears responsibility for fraud, compromised keys and failed transactions as traditional financial assets move onto blockchains.
items.one_line_summary: 美联储理事 Waller 借 Binance 黑客事件警告代币化金融责任不清，链上资产合规与托管风险溢价需重估
items.technical_summary: 美联储理事 Christopher Waller 在谈到传统金融资产上链时，引用 Binance 黑客事件，追问欺诈、私钥泄露和失败交易由谁担责。原文只给出讲话要点，没有披露该黑客事件的损失金额、发生时间、受影响资产规模，也没有给出代币化市场的量化数据。对加密量化交易者而言，这指向一个监管风险变量：代币化资产的托管、私钥管理和结算失败责任若不明，相关资产的流动性折价和风险溢价可能上升。短期更可能影响消息面情绪和合规托管类代币/交易所相关资产，而非直接改变价格因子。
key_points: Waller 以 Binance 黑客事件为例，警告代币化金融的欺诈、私钥泄露和失败交易责任不清；原文未披露损失金额、时间与资产规模。
加密量化交易者应把“托管/私钥/结算失败”加入代币化资产风险模型，重点监控交易所安全事件、合规托管方和链上异常转账。
原文是简短新闻摘要，未说明 Binance 黑客事件的具体时间、损失和监管后续，单条讲话不足以形成交易信号，需等待正式讲话稿或监管文件。

items.title: Ethereum Devs Weigh a Scaling Upgrade That Could Break 15,000 Apps
items.raw_text: Developers warned on a core dev call that two scaling changes in the Glamsterdam upgrade break assumptions some contracts rely on—pitting a 3.3x capacity boost against the risk of disrupting thousands of apps.
items.abstract: Developers warned on a core dev call that two scaling changes in the Glamsterdam upgrade break assumptions some contracts rely on—pitting a 3.3x capacity boost against the risk of disrupting thousands of apps.
items.one_line_summary: 以太坊 Glamsterdam 升级权衡 3.3 倍扩容与 1.5 万应用兼容风险，DeFi 合约与 ETH 波动或受冲击
items.technical_summary: 以太坊核心开发者会议讨论 Glamsterdam 升级中的两项扩容改动，目标将网络容量提升约 3.3 倍。问题在于这些改动会改变部分智能合约依赖的假设，可能影响约 15,000 个应用。开发者需要在扩容收益与生态兼容风险之间权衡。对量化交易者，重点是升级时间表、受影响协议、gas 市场变化和 ETH 价格波动。
key_points: Glamsterdam 两项扩容改动目标提升 3.3 倍容量，但可能破坏约 1.5 万个应用依赖的合约假设。
量化交易者应监控升级时间表、受影响 DeFi 协议和 gas 费变化，评估 ETH 波动与协议敞口。
报道未列出具体 EIP、时间表和受影响应用名单，信息来自开发者会议转述，需以官方文档核实。
items.quant_relevance: 风险建模：升级兼容性风险影响 DeFi 协议敞口与 ETH 波动；执行/交易成本：容量提升可能压低 gas 费，但合约故障会放大链上执行风险。
items.possible_use_case: 可作为 ETH 事件驱动波动信号参考：升级前后监测 gas 费、DeFi TVL 和协议异常，调整做市与杠杆。
items.limitations: 报道极短，未说明两项改动的具体 EIP、实施时间和受影响应用清单；缺乏链上数据与量化回测，社区讨论可能放大风险。

items.title: CFTC nominee questions public benefit of prediction markets as legal fight grows
items.raw_text: One of the two picks to join the regulatory commission, Democratic nominee Matthew Rowland, said he hopes to have a say in prediction markets rulemaking.
items.abstract: One of the two picks to join the regulatory commission, Democratic nominee Matthew Rowland, said he hopes to have a say in prediction markets rulemaking.
items.one_line_summary: CFTC 民主党提名人 Rowland 质疑预测市场「公共利益」，事件合约监管立法或再添变数
items.technical_summary: 美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）两个委员提名人之一的民主党人 Matthew Rowland 在提名阶段公开表态，称希望对预测市场（prediction markets）的规则制定「有发言权」，并对这类产品是否具备公共利益提出疑问。当前 CFTC 正与预测市场平台处于持续的法律对抗中，委员席位的人事变动会直接改变规则制定与执法取向。对交易者而言，这意味着事件合约类产品（如美国大选、宏观数据、体育赛事合约）的合规边界、可上线品种和流动性可能在中期内被重新划定。原文未给出任何具体条款、时间表或量化数据。
key_points: CFTC 五席委员会的两名提名人之一、民主党人 Matthew Rowland 公开质疑预测市场的公共利益属性，并要求参与相关规则制定，背景是 CFTC 与预测市场平台的法律战持续扩大
对事件合约交易者的直接影响：美国境内预测市场的可上线品种、杠杆与准入规则存在被收紧的政策尾部风险，持有相关头寸需评估监管事件触发的流动性与价差跳变
信息密度低——原文仅转述提名人的一句表态，未披露投票时间表、具体规则草案或委员席位构成变化，政策落地路径与概率均不可量化
items.quant_relevance: 风险建模 / 执行与交易成本（事件合约、预测市场头寸的监管折价与流动性风险）
items.possible_use_case: 把「CFTC 委员提名与预测市场诉讼进展」加入政策事件日历，作为 Polymarket/Kalshi 类事件合约头寸的仓位上限触发条件；同时在跨市场套利策略中给美国境内事件合约加一层监管折价系数。
items.limitations: 原文仅一句话，无投票日程、无规则草案、无委员席位票数结构，无法量化政策落地概率；这是政策表态而非既成规则，实际影响可能被后续提名流程稀释；新闻源单一（CoinDesk），需交叉核对 CFTC 官方声明与提名听证记录后再用于交易决策。
